I was charged twice for my monthly subscription and nobody explained why.
The refund took three weeks to arrive and I had to ask twice.
Payment failed even though my card is fine, very frustrating.
Why did the price go up without any notification? Billing feels shady.
I cancelled my plan but the charge still appeared on my statement.
Invoice shows the wrong amount, I had to ask for a corrected one.
Cannot update my credit card details, the payment page keeps failing.
Subscription renewed automatically and I did not get a reminder email.
The discount code was accepted but the final payment ignored it.
Refund policy is confusing and the payment history page is unclear.
The app crashes every time I open the settings screen.
After the latest update the app freezes on startup.
Notifications stopped working and the app lags a lot.
App crashes when I try to upload a photo, please fix this bug.
Screen goes blank after login, I have to restart the app each time.
The app drains my battery and sometimes crashes in the background.
Search is broken, it returns nothing and then the app hangs.
Sync fails randomly and the app throws an error message.
Dark mode causes flickering and the app crashes on rotate.
Video playback stutters and the app closes unexpectedly.
Support took five days to answer my simple question.
The support agent was friendly and solved my problem in minutes.
Nobody from customer service replied to my emails.
Chat support kept sending me copy-paste answers that did not help.
Great help from the support team, very polite and fast.
I was transferred between three agents and had to repeat everything.
Support closed my ticket without solving the issue.
Waiting time for the support hotline is far too long.
The support team followed up the next day to make sure it was fixed.
Customer service was rude and dismissive about my complaint.
The interface is clean and very easy to navigate.
Menus are confusing and I cannot find basic features.
Love the new design, the colors and layout look modern.
Text is too small and the buttons are hard to tap.
The onboarding screens are helpful and nicely designed.
Too many steps to do simple things, the layout feels cluttered.
Beautiful interface but the navigation could be more intuitive.
The new layout hides the features I use most.
Simple, minimal and pleasant to use every day.
Icons are unclear and the home screen looks messy.
